All seven supplied Alicke locators repeat Study 1/page 10 without identifying the outcome, factor contrast, or test. No assignment from input order was made. Primary author replication report is available at /home/lukas/.t3/worktrees/fred-data/audit-fred-stats-2026-10/audit/fred_stats_2026-10/texts/40deccbb20c2694e4576aa45.txt. Its named target is the outcome-by-norm interaction, but this does not disambiguate seven assigned effects. Source follow-up: Original target only. Source inspected: /home/lukas/.t3/worktrees/fred-data/audit-fred-stats-2026-10/audit/fred_stats_2026-10/texts/followup_248443174d2e2b857e32c93d.txt. Title and authors match the reference, but this is an author manuscript with running header Causation and Culpability, not the journal-paginated publication; its precise date/version is not supplied. The assigned locator p. 10 contains conceptual discussion, not the target statistical results. Study 1 results on manuscript pp. 13–15 report multiple F tests for blame-praise and causal ratings, including interactions and several distinct contrasts. Neither the neutral description nor the study identifier distinguishes the intended outcome/comparison. The seven assigned rows provide no independent distinguishing test locators; no statistic is assigned by row order. Manuscript p. 12 footnote 2 gives an overall recruited sample and Figures 2–3 on pp. 13–14 give differing condition sets, but a target-specific analytic n cannot be assigned without identifying the test. All target statistic fields are therefore null; manuscript and published values have not been assumed equal.
